plan.title: Regretted Item Crossed Out in Buyer QCS

steps.note: Open an existing event suitable for the regret and QCS flow.
Move to the invited vendor portal for the vendor-side action.
Open this event's pricing round in the vendor portal.

args.need: as the vendor, use Quick Fill → Regret Item for the target line item and submit the regret

steps.note: The catalog has no vendor regret-item action.
Return to the buyer's event page.
Open the buyer's comparison grid after the regret is submitted.

args.goal: on the buyer's Master QCS, verify that the regretted line item for that vendor is visibly crossed out; stop when the crossed-out item is shown

steps.note: Inspect the visual strike-through styling that no assertion step can directly express.
Confirm the QCS identifies the line as regretted.
